status: POST HOC: not pre-registered, no ledger entry; analysis of committed MD and bond-angle results
shell_source: bond_angles sic_radial: angle s.d. < 0.1 deg to r = 1.45 nm, jumps to 4.8 deg at 1.5-1.6 nm (nominal R = 2.0 nm, x = 0.3)

models.const: lam2 = L (one contrast for all radii, the current P1 assumption, refitted)
models.a_core_fraction: lam2 = L_inf * f_core, f_core = ((R - s)/R)^3 (contrast proportional to crystalline-core volume fraction)
models.a2_core_amplitude: lam2 = L_inf * f_core^2 (core-only scattering amplitude, shell inert)
models.b_core_shell: lam2 = (a_core f_core + a_shell (1 - f_core))^2 (volume-averaged Rayleigh amplitude; shell is a disordered layer with its own signed contrast)
